title: Create core delay tests with cmake registration
description:
Create tests/DspCoreTests.cpp and register the four new DSP source files plus the new test file in CMakeLists.txt. CMakeLists.txt is owned only by this task in phase c.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt (existing plugin target, existing console test-runner target and its CTest registration from phase b; reuse the existing runner target rather than creating a second one)
- tests/ (existing test file style and juce::UnitTest registration pattern from phase b)
- Source/DSP/FractionalDelay.h, Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h, Source/DSP/DelayTimeController.h, Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h (public APIs to test)

Required tests, written with the built-in juce::UnitTest framework only (Catch2, GoogleTest, and every other third-party framework are forbidden):
1. Impulse first-repeat placement: for sample rates 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000, and 192000 Hz, feed an impulse and assert the first repeat appears at round(Fs * T) samples.
2. Fractional interpolation: for several mu values in [0,1), compare FractionalDelay's output against Lagrange values computed independently inside the test from L_minus1 = -mu*(mu-1)*(mu-2)/6, L_0 = (mu+1)*(mu-1)*(mu-2)/2, L_1 = -(mu+1)*mu*(mu-2)/2, L_2 = (mu+1)*mu*(mu-1)/6, within a stated float tolerance.
3. Clamp tests: a negative effective time (short sync ratio plus a negative fine offset) clamps the read position to 8 samples, and an over-long request clamps to 8.25 seconds.
4. T60 decay: measure 20*log10(A(T60)/A(0)) and assert it is approximately -60 dB within a stated tolerance; also assert the returned feedback gain never exceeds 0.985, including with Hold active.
5. Tap median: five tap intervals containing one outlier outside 100-3000 ms yield the median of the accepted intervals and reject the outlier.
6. BPM fallback: with bpmValid false and no prior valid BPM, the resolved tempo is 120 BPM; after a valid BPM is seen, that last valid BPM is retained when bpmValid goes false.

CMakeLists.txt edits are limited to: adding Source/DSP/FractionalDelay.cpp, Source/DSP/FeedbackController.cpp, Source/DSP/DelayTimeController.cpp, and Source/DSP/DelayVoice.cpp to the plugin target sources, and adding tests/DspCoreTests.cpp to the existing console test-runner target so it runs under CTest. Do not change presets, targets, JUCE options, or add dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: tests/DspCoreTests.cpp exists and uses only juce::UnitTest, with no Catch2, GoogleTest, or other third-party test framework
CMakeLists.txt adds the four new DSP .cpp files to the plugin target and tests/DspCoreTests.cpp to the existing console test-runner target
cmake --build build -j configures and builds all targets successfully

ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure passes the test asserting FractionalDelay output matches independently computed Lagrange values within a stated tolerance
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure passes the clamp tests for 8 samples minimum and 8.25 seconds maximum
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure passes the T60 test asserting 20*log10(A(T60)/A(0)) is approximately -60 dB and that feedback gain never exceeds 0.985 including with Hold active
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure passes the tap-median outlier-rejection test and the 120 BPM fallback and last-valid-BPM retention tests
